transcript.text: Hey, it's Jordan. I had to step out of the Q3 product review meeting for a bit. Are you still watching it? I need to catch up on what I'm missing.

Hi Jordan, yes I'm still watching. Here's what you missed so far: Dana set the agenda — Q3 roadmap, Atlas launch date, and budget. The Atlas launch is confirmed for September 18th. Marcus said the backend migration is 80% done, with the billing service remaining, about two weeks of work. And Priya reported the new onboarding flow cut drop-off from 34% to 19% in the A/B test. I'll keep watching and update you as it continues.
Oh wow, that's great news about the onboarding test! So wait, the Atlas launch is September 18th? That's sooner than I thought. What else are they covering right now?

Yes, the Atlas launch is confirmed for September 18th. Since the onboarding update, here's what's been covered: The budget — marketing gets an extra $150,000 for the Atlas launch campaign. A key risk was raised: the CDN vendor contract expires August 30, so renewal must be signed before launch. Action items: Marcus owns the CDN renewal with a deadline of August 15, and Priya ships onboarding v2 by August 1. Also, the user research sessions were moved to July 28 and 29. And a final headcount decision — you're approved to hire two more engineers in Q4. The meeting is on the Risks & Dependencies slide now. I'll keep watching.

Nice, so Marcus is handling the CDN renewal by August 15th - got it. And we got the extra $150k for marketing, that's what we were hoping for! Is there anything else coming up or are they wrapping things up?

The meeting just wrapped up — Dana said "That's all, thanks everyone. Notes will be shared after the call." Here's your full recap of the Q3 Product Review: 1) Atlas launch is confirmed for September 18th. 2) Backend migration is 80% done; only the billing service remains, about two weeks of work. 3) The new onboarding flow cut drop-off from 34% to 19% in the A/B test. 4) Budget: marketing gets an extra $150,000 for the Atlas launch campaign. 5) Key risk: the CDN vendor contract expires August 30 and must be renewed before launch. 6) Action items — Marcus owns the CDN renewal, due August 15; Priya ships onboarding v2 by August 1. 7) User research sessions moved to July 28 and 29. 8) Headcount decision: approved to hire two more engineers in Q4. Notes will be shared after the call.
